summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure) for cipher-box, then review/simplify the code, create a PR, and resolve all automated reviewer comments until CI passes.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 was executed successfully (3 plans, 9 commits), code was simplified, PR #361 was created and all CodeRabbit/Copilot review threads were resolved. CI is still failing on the recovery E2E spec due to missing SDK_E2E_SECRET env var and missing Kubo CORS config in CI.

repo: Device registry has a v1/v2 schema migration — v1 records with empty ipHash are auto-healed to SHA-256 hash on read; other malformed values are rejected
publishWithVerify in bin/index.ts should publish once then retry only the verification step, not re-publish on each retry
computeIpHash('0.0.0.0') already exists in apps/web/src/lib/device/info.ts — no need to inline SHA-256 in useAuth.ts
SDK E2E tests use SDK_E2E_SECRET env var; Web E2E workflow was not passing this secret, causing 401 on /auth/test-login
Kubo CORS is not configured on either local Docker host (192.168.133.12) or CI — browser cannot fetch from Kubo gateway (8080) or API (5001) cross-origin
Recovery.html resolveIpns falls back to CipherBox API at localhost:3000 as last resort, but fetchFromIpfs still hits Kubo directly — both need CORS or a proxy
loadBin auto-repair now publishes an empty bin immediately, so fresh bins return sequenceNumber: 1 instead of 0 — bin-operations.test.ts and integration.test.ts both needed updating
Package declaration files (.d.ts) can become stale after code changes — rebuilding @cipherbox/crypto and @cipherbox/api-client resolved 6 phantom TypeScript errors in the web app
TypeScript does not propagate narrowing from called functions back to caller — validateRegistryShape() narrows obj.devices inside its scope but caller still sees unknown[], requiring an explicit cast

code.finding: publishWithVerify was re-publishing on every retry iteration; fix: publish once outside the retry loop, retry only the verification check
validateRegistryShape() extracted to deduplicate v1/v2 validation; but caller needs explicit 'as unknown[]' cast after calling it due to TS cross-function narrowing limitation
cid and pinSize must be declared with 'let' ABOVE the try block so the finally block can access them — declaring inside try makes them out of scope in finally
Uses computeIpHash() from device/info.ts — replaces 7 lines of inline SHA-256 hex encoding
Web E2E workflow sets TEST_LOGIN_SECRET for the API process but was missing SDK_E2E_SECRET for the test runner — recovery.spec.ts imports createTestAccount which reads SDK_E2E_SECRET
Expected sequenceNumber: 0 for fresh bin, must be 1 now that loadBin auto-repairs by publishing immediately
Same sequenceNumber issue — updated to expect 1 after auto-repair change

workflow: GSD phase execution with 3 parallel subagents completed cleanly — wave 1 all independent, no cross-plan dependencies
Stale package builds can mask real type errors; always rebuild dependent packages before concluding type errors are genuine
When merging main into a feature branch with planning file conflicts, keep both phases' completion data (both marked complete)
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded error in Claude Code is a runtime bug fired after tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARY.md + commits to confirm actual success

friction: Background bash commands for commit+push raced with explicit sequential push, causing exit code 128 failures on the background tasks (harmless but noisy)
Docker host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) mid-session, breaking API .env and requiring manual update
Kubo CORS not configured anywhere (local or CI) — recovery E2E test fundamentally cannot work from a browser without either CORS headers on Kubo or an API proxy for IPFS content
Recovery.spec.ts was written with hardcoded localhost:8080/5001 gateway URLs that only work if Kubo is on localhost with CORS — local Docker setup requires the actual host IP

TypeScript DTS build failure in CI (TS18046 on registry/schema.ts:96) was caused by the refactor to extract validateRegistryShape() — required adding explicit cast that wasn't needed before the refactor
open_items: Recovery E2E test still failing in CI — needs Kubo CORS configured in e2e.yml (ipfs config commands added but not yet confirmed working)
Recovery spec gateway URLs are hardcoded to localhost — should be env-configurable for local development against a remote Docker host
Stashed changes to recovery.spec.ts (env-configurable gateways) were dropped — may need to be re-applied if the localhost CORS fix doesn't fully resolve the CI failure
Kubo on local Docker host (192.168.133.12) still has no CORS configured — recovery.html cannot be tested locally without either Kubo CORS or an API proxy for /ipfs/{cid} content
Two SDK integration tests always fail locally due to API not running (ECONNREFUSED) — these are expected infra gaps but add noise to test runs
